Definition: to join (literally or figuratively); specifically (by means of spells) to fascinate
BiblicalUsage: 1) to unite, join, bind together, be joined, be coupled, be in league, heap up, have fellowship with, be compact, be a charmer; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to unite, be joined; 1a2) to tie magic charms, charm; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to unite with, make an ally of; 1b2) to unite, join, ally; 1c) (Pual); 1c1) to be allied with, be united; 1c2) to be joined together; 1d) (Hiphil) to join together, pile up (words); 1e) (Hithpael) to join oneself to, make an alliance, league together
